title: PostReady: PR #548 — Stop AI images rendering garbled signs, logos and brand badges
description: Tightened Pro Prompt and image no-branding guard to eliminate garbled landmark signs, fake brand badges, and doubled text.

title: PostReady: PR #549 — Rewrite Pro Prompt as a Seedream-tuned visual-spec compiler (Phase 1)
description: Rewrote Pro Prompt image-side to match Seedream 4.5 prompting style: front-loaded subject+action, explicit object counts, positive geometry contracts, one light source, quoted exact text only when wanted.

title: PostReady: PR #550 — Show/hide eye toggle on password fields
description: Added show/hide eye toggle button to password input fields, letting users reveal or mask their password as they type.

title: PostReady: PR #551 — Stop captions all sounding the same
description: Updated caption generation to vary tone, structure, and phrasing so batch captions no longer sound repetitive or formulaic.

title: PostReady: PR #552 — Show business name above Sign out, not owner name
description: Dashboard header now displays the client business name above the Sign out link instead of the owner's personal name, improving multi-client clarity.

title: PostReady: PR #553 — Show client logo in dashboard header
description: The dashboard header now displays the client's logo, personalizing the portal for each business using PostReady.

title: PostReady: PR #554 — Don't reject a website typed without http://
description: Relaxed website URL validation to accept domains entered without http:// prefix, auto-normalizing them so users aren't blocked by a formatting requirement.

title: PostReady: PR #555 — Connected social cards: per-platform gradients (Design 4)
description: Connected social platform cards now use per-platform gradient backgrounds (Design 4), giving each platform a distinct visual identity on the dashboard.

title: PostReady: PR #556 — Bolder platform gradients + gradient on available cards
description: Strengthened per-platform gradient intensity on connected social cards and extended the gradient treatment to available (not-yet-connected) platform cards.

title: PostReady: PR #557 — Premium frosted social cards (subtle per-platform gradient system)
description: Connected social platform cards upgraded to a premium frosted glass aesthetic with a subtle, refined per-platform gradient system — more polished than the bold Design 4 gradients.
